Numerology Calculator
Your Life Path Number — the core number in numerology, calculated from your date of birth.

How the Life Path Number is calculated

Your Life Path Number is the central number in numerology. The calculator adds together every digit of your date of birth — day, month and year — and keeps adding the digits of the result until it reaches a single number from 1 to 9.

The exceptions are 11, 22 and 33. These are called master numbers, and numerologists leave them unreduced because they are read as carrying a stronger version of their meaning.

What your number is used for

Numerologists read the Life Path Number as a picture of your natural temperament and the themes that run through your life. It is often read alongside your name number and personal year number, which together give a fuller picture than any single figure.

Frequently asked

Common questions

What is a Life Path Number?

It is a single number worked out from your full date of birth, and it is the number numerologists look at first.

What are master numbers?

11, 22 and 33. When your total reaches one of these it is not reduced further, because each is read as a heightened form of its root number.

Do I need my birth time?

No. The Life Path Number uses only your date of birth.
